senses.gloss: m. pl. (preced.) dried up, laid dry.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 72a:11">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>אַקְּפוּ פירא דכוורי ל׳ בשבתא</he> Ar. they surrounded (with nets, mats &c.) a pond of fish that were laid dry on the Sabbath (to prevent the fish from being swept along with the coming flood); [for differ. version and interpret., v. <cite ref="S01694"><he>קְפָא</he></cite>].
